conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Neeraj Kumar. Mera credit card ka reward points expire kyun ho rahe hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Neeraj ji, main check karta hoon. Kya aap apna card number bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Maine dekha, aapke card ke points 2 saal baad expire hote hain as per terms. Aapke kuch points kal expire hone wale hain. Kya aap redeem karna chahte hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Main aapko redemption process ke steps app ya website pe mail karta hoon. Koi aur madad?
